name: loop-guard
description: Observe and safely interrupt high-confidence repeated tool failures without limiting legitimate long-running Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Detect repeated tool failures without hard call limits.
interface.longDescription: Tracks exact repeated tool calls and explicit failures per Codex turn. It starts in observe-only mode, stores no raw prompts or tool payloads, and can later block only a fourth identical failed call while allowing the agent to choose another strategy.
defaultPrompt: Inspect Loop Guard's current mode and recent candidates.
Explain how Loop Guard protects long-running tasks.
